data/0/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.english: The eyeball serves as both a map and a key to the cult's hideout. When a creature holding the eyeball speaks the key phrase, "Hail the Undying," the eyeball glows with green light before spinning to look in the direction of the cult's hideout (acting like a compass).
data/0/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 這顆眼球既是通往邪教藏身處的地圖，也是鑰匙。持握眼球的生物說出通關口令「不死者萬歲」時，眼球便會泛起綠光，隨後轉向邪教藏身處的方向，如同指南針一般。
data/0/entries/5/entries/5/entries/0.reason: translate password consistently and repair broken quotation marks

data/3/entries/6/entries/11/entries/12/e.english: The treant's roots have warped and splintered the floorboards, rendering squares with roots {@book difficult terrain|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}.
data/3/entries/6/entries/11/entries/12/e.zh_tw: 樹人的根鬚使地板扭曲、碎裂；有根鬚盤踞的方格視為{@book 困難地形|PHB|8|Difficult Terrain}。
data/3/entries/6/entries/11/entries/12/e.reason: chapter index 8 was incorrectly added as a page number; preserve canonical reference

data/6/entries/8/entries/8/entries/32/en.english: {@b Black Mirrors}: Royal quarters ({@area area V28|340|x}) and Akaazi's quarters ({@area area V36|357|x})
data/6/entries/8/entries/8/entries/32/en.zh_tw: {@b 黑色鏡子}：王室居所（{@area 區域V28|340|x}）與阿卡茲的居所（{@area 區域V36|357|x}）

data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: The door in the east wall of this otherwise empty room bears the inscription "DOLINDAR" above "NO WORLD TO RETURN." Every letter of each word is set into the wall on a separate tile.
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 這個房間除此之外空無一物。東牆上的門刻著「DOLINDAR」，下方是「NO WORLD TO RETURN.」——多林達爾，無處可歸。每個單字中的每個字母，都各自刻在一塊嵌入牆內的石磚上。
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.reason: retain the exact letter tiles required by the ALONE puzzle

data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: The door is sealed with a puzzle that requires pushing the right letter tiles in sequence. A pushed letter makes its whole word sink into the door with a click. The door unlocks when the correct combination is input. (Pushing a second letter in the same word doesn't do anything.) The correct combination, which causes the wall to slide aside, is to push the letters spelling ALONE in this order:
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 這扇門由一道謎題封住，必須依序按下正確的字母磚才能開啟。按下一個字母時，該字母所屬的整個單字會喀嚓一聲陷入門中。輸入正確組合後，門便會解鎖。（再按同一單字中的第二個字母不會產生效果。）依下列順序按下字母，拼出ALONE（孤獨），牆壁就會滑開：
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.reason: preserve five-word input order and clarify clue without changing puzzle

data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.english: The first time a character pushes the tiles incorrectly, they see a small mechanism below the phrase "NO WORLD TO RETURN." This mechanism is a lock. As an action, a character with thieves' tools can use them to try to pick the lock, doing so with a successful {@dc 16} Dexterity ({@skill Sleight of Hand}) check. Picking the lock has the same effect as solving the puzzle, granting access to area B6.
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.zh_tw: 角色第一次按錯字母磚時，會注意到「NO WORLD TO RETURN.」下方有個小機關，那是一道鎖。持有盜賊工具的角色可以用一個動作嘗試撬鎖，成功通過{@dc 16}敏捷（{@skill Sleight of Hand||巧手}）檢定即可打開。撬開鎖與解開謎題的效果相同，都能讓角色進入B6區域。
data/1/entries/8/entries/2/entries/6/ent.reason: retain English inscription locator and exact alternate thieves-tools solution

data/13/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.english: Nowhere are Alustriel and her deeds better known than in the Silver Marches and its capital, Silverymoon. Alustriel ruled Silverymoon for centuries, once disguised as a wizard named Elué Dualen and then later in her true form. She helped create Silverymoon's famous Moonbridge and co-founded the Lady's College, the first school in Faerûn for mages as students rather than as apprentices in service.
data/13/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.zh_tw: 沒有任何地方比銀色聯邦及其首都銀月城更熟悉艾拉斯卓和她的事蹟。艾拉斯卓統治銀月城數個世紀，起初化名為法師艾露耶·杜阿倫，後來才恢復真實身分。她協助建造了銀月城著名的月橋，也共同創立了女士學院；這是費倫第一所以法師為正式學生，而非服侍導師的學徒，來提供教育的學院。
data/13/entries/2/entries/4/entries/1.reason: remove unsupported association of Lady's College with Sune; consistent personal name

data/8/entries/5/entries/10/entries/2/en.reason: 移除中文來源擅加的角色介紹；原文只有稱號。

data/9/entries/5/entries/4/entries/5.english: After a few minutes, the wizards regain their poise and tell the characters all the information in the beginning of this section. Alustriel and Tasha are willing to submit to magical means of determining the truth. They never deceived the characters, and they never wanted anything more than to stop Vecna's ritual.
data/9/entries/5/entries/4/entries/5.zh_tw: 幾分鐘後，兩位法師恢復鎮定，將本節開頭的所有資訊告訴角色們。艾拉斯卓和塔莎願意接受魔法檢驗，以證明所言屬實。她們從未欺騙角色們，始終只想阻止維克那的儀式。
data/9/entries/5/entries/4/entries/5.reason: 修正雙重否定誤譯，保留兩名法師並未欺騙隊伍的事實。

data/8/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.english: Dragon's Pride occupies the lower floor of the casino and is accessed via an elevator. This elevator is magically concealed within the back of the large dragon statue in the casino's lobby. To view the elevator's entrance and pass through, a creature must bear the club's mark: an enchanted tattoo of a dragon claw. Only Windfall and the casino's pit masters can bestow or remove this tattoo. As soon as the tiefling or a pit master grants permission to enter Dragon's Pride, the mark magically appears on a creature's hand. To creatures lacking the mark, the club's elevator is undetectable and impassable by any other means.
data/8/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.zh_tw: 龍后之傲位於賭場下層，須搭乘升降梯進入。升降梯以魔法隱藏在賭場大廳的大型龍雕像背面。生物必須帶有俱樂部的標記——附有魔法的龍爪刺青——才能看見並穿過升降梯入口。只有意外之財和賭場主管能賦予或移除這道刺青。這名提夫林或任何一位賭場主管一旦准許某個生物進入龍后之傲，標記就會魔法般地出現在該生物的手上。沒有標記的生物無法偵知升降梯，也無法用任何其他方式通過入口。
data/8/entries/7/entries/2/entries/0.reason: 修正提夫林種族與賭場主管職稱，保留出入限制。

data/4/entries/8/entries/5/entries/20/en.english: Three Cyran soldiers in full regalia stand diligently at the arrow slits in this 30-foot-tall gathering hall. When they become aware of the characters, the soldiers turn to the party, revealing ghostly, screaming skulls instead of faces. The soldiers are three hostile {@creature Wight||wights}. Three {@creature Will-o'-Wisp||will-o'-wisps}, previously {@condition invisible}, appear at the start of combat and fight alongside the wights.
data/4/entries/8/entries/5/entries/20/en.zh_tw: 三名身著全套軍服的塞爾士兵，在這座高30尺的集會大廳中守在箭孔旁。察覺角色們後，士兵轉過身來，露出的不是臉孔，而是幽靈般尖叫的骷髏頭。這三名士兵是敵對的{@creature Wight||屍妖}。三隻原本處於{@condition invisible||隱形}狀態的{@creature Will-o'-Wisp||鬼火}會在戰鬥開始時現身，與屍妖並肩作戰。
data/4/entries/8/entries/5/entries/20/en.reason: 刪除原文沒有的巫妖，保留三名屍妖、三隻鬼火及先前隱形狀態。

data/1/entries/5/entries/0.english: This adventure begins when Lord Dagult Neverember summons the characters to his modest villa in Neverwinter. Several local guards are present, as are three priests of Oghma—a god of inspiration, invention, and knowledge—from Neverwinter's House of Knowledge.
data/1/entries/5/entries/0.zh_tw: 冒險開始時，達格魯特·無燼領主召角色們前往他位於無冬城的樸素別墅。現場有幾名本地守衛，還有三位來自無冬城知識殿堂、信奉靈感、發明與知識之神歐格瑪的祭司。
data/1/entries/5/entries/0.reason: 補回領主名字，理順神祇與祭司的從屬關係。

data/0/entries/10/entries/2/entries/5/ro.english: The character is in the employ of a powerful merchant, mage, or monarch who sent the character to Lord Neverember as a favor. Neverember needed the character's help to handle growing problems with undead in Neverwinter. The emergency involving the missing nobles is the character's most recent assignment.
data/0/entries/10/entries/2/entries/5/ro.zh_tw: 角色受僱於一位有權勢的商人、法師或君主，對方為了賣無燼領主一個人情，派角色前去效力。無燼需要角色協助處理無冬城日益嚴重的不死生物問題；貴族失蹤的緊急事件就是角色最近接到的任務。
data/0/entries/10/entries/2/entries/5/ro.reason: 補回無冬城，修正「送往伯爵」的受僱關係。

data/9/entries/2.english: The fake Mordenkainen reveals himself to be {@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR}, Vecna's former ally and current archenemy. The characters must chase Kas across the multiverse to Pandesmos, the first layer of the plane of Pandemonium, where the vampire plans to co-opt Vecna's ritual and become the most powerful being in existence.
data/9/entries/2.zh_tw: 冒充魔鄧肯的人揭露自己其實是{@creature Kas the Betrayer|VEoR}，他曾是維克那的盟友，如今卻是維克那的死敵。角色們必須跨越多元宇宙追趕凱斯，前往喧癲空隧位面的第一層——潘德斯莫斯。這名吸血鬼計劃在那裡篡奪維克那的儀式，成為一切存在之中最強大的個體。
data/9/entries/2.reason: 修正位面與第一層的上下關係被顛倒。

data/4/entries/4/entries/1/items/0/entry.english: The Mournland is a ruined wasteland. Before the Last War—a global conflict waged across the continent of Khorvaire for over a century—the Mournland was the nation of Cyre. An apocalyptic event called the Day of Mourning destroyed Cyre and transformed the region. Remnants of the Last War's battlefields, such as the fire-spewing war machines known as colossi, lie strewn about the Mournland, and warforged wander the land.
data/4/entries/4/entries/1/items/0/entry.zh_tw: 悲悼荒原是一片毀壞的荒地。在終末戰爭——席捲科瓦雷大陸、持續一個多世紀的全球衝突——之前，此地是塞爾王國。一場名為悲悼之日的末日災變摧毀了塞爾，改變了整個地區。終末戰爭的戰場殘跡散落於悲悼荒原各處，包括被稱為巨像的噴火戰爭機器；戰俑也在這片土地上徘徊。
data/4/entries/4/entries/1/items/0/entry.reason: 補回科瓦雷地名及塞爾國家身分，統一戰鑄譯名。

data/10/entries/5/entries/5/entries/3/en.english: The winds of Pandemonium aren't audible within the tower, so they don't impede hearing. However, noisy chittering from a million tiny vermin echoes throughout. The chittering masks noise from combat, so tower denizens have disadvantage on Wisdom ({@skill Perception}) checks to hear anything outside the area they're in.
data/10/entries/5/entries/5/entries/3/en.zh_tw: 喧癲空隧的風在塔內聽不見，所以它們不會妨礙聽覺。然而，成千上萬的小害蟲發出的嘈雜的啁啾聲在各處迴響。這種啁啾聲掩蓋了戰鬥的噪音，所以塔內的居民在進行感知（{@skill Perception||感知}）檢定以聽到他們所在區域外的任何聲音時，會有劣勢。
data/10/entries/5/entries/5/entries/3/en.reason: 原文為 Pandemonium 位面的風，不是 Pandesmos 第一層名稱。

data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/2/en.english: The three driders squad leaders are resting away from Pandemonium's winds here. Rachazz infiltrated the tower and is collecting information for Miska about Camlash's forces.
data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/2/en.zh_tw: 這三位蛛化卓爾小隊領袖在這裡休息，遠離喧癲空隧的風。拉查茲潛入了塔樓，正在為米斯卡收集有關卡姆拉什軍隊的資訊。
data/10/entries/5/entries/6/entries/2/en.reason: 原文為 Pandemonium 位面的風，不是 Pandesmos 第一層名稱。

data/10/entries/7/entries/3/entries/4/en.english: The winds of Pandemonium are distantly audible within the redoubt. They don't impede hearing within the redoubt.
data/10/entries/7/entries/3/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 喧癲空隧的風聲在堡壘內部可以隱約聽到。它們不會妨礙堡壘內部的聽覺。
data/10/entries/7/entries/3/entries/4/en.reason: 原文為 Pandemonium 位面的風，不是 Pandesmos 第一層名稱。

data/10/entries/7/entries/4/entries/4/en.english: This wide chamber has ascending stairs at one end and descending stairs at the other. The shrunken, bloodless corpses of four people and two driders surround a stone throne in the room's center. One wall bears a series of tiny holes, through which the wailing winds of Pandemonium are distantly audible.
data/10/entries/7/entries/4/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 這個寬敞的房間一端有向上的樓梯，另一端有向下的樓梯。四個人的萎縮、無血的屍體和兩個蛛化卓爾圍繞著房間中心的石制寶座。一面牆上有一系列小孔，透過這些小孔可以隱約聽到喧癲空隧的哀嚎風聲。
data/10/entries/7/entries/4/entries/4/en.reason: 原文為 Pandemonium 位面的風，不是 Pandesmos 第一層名稱。

data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/3/ent.english: For each ounce of graymatter fluid consumed, the creature takes 11 ({@dice 2d10}) psychic damage. A creature killed by this damage rises as a {@creature zombie} {@dice 1d4} hours after dying.
data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/3/ent.zh_tw: 生物每喝下一盎司灰質流體，就受到11（{@dice 2d10}）點心靈傷害。被這種傷害殺死的生物，會在死亡{@dice 1d4}小時後化為{@creature zombie}起身。
data/4/entries/8/entries/4/entries/3/ent.reason: 修正復起時點：「小時後」不是「小時內」。

data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/20/en.english: Thin, leather-bound journal written in Common that explains that the combination for the crypt doors ({@area area T25|3e1|x}) is the word "die" in Draconic
data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/20/en.zh_tw: 一本薄薄的皮革裝訂日記，以通用語寫成，記載墓室大門（{@area 區域T25|3e1|x}）的密碼是龍語的「die」（死）一詞
data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/20/en.reason: 補上密碼字義，保留辨識字母所需的英文。

data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/24/en.english: The notes also explain that the combination for the crypt doors ({@area area T25|3e1|x}) is the word "die" in Draconic.
data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/24/en.zh_tw: 筆記也說明，墓室大門（{@area 區域T25|3e1|x}）的密碼是龍語的「die」（死）一詞。
data/7/entries/5/entries/3/entries/24/en.reason: 補上密碼字義，與另一份線索一致。

data/10/entries/6/entries/5/entries/2/na.reason: Drill Field 是軍隊操練場，不是鑽探場；房間編號維持 Y1。

data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.english: You gain a special intuition for secrets. You have advantage on Wisdom ({@skill Insight}) checks. In addition, you can use an action to cast {@spell See Invisibility} without expending a spell slot. Once you cast that spell in this way, you can't do so again until you finish a long rest.
data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.zh_tw: 你對秘密獲得特殊的直覺。你進行感知（{@skill Insight}）檢定時具有優勢。此外，你可以使用一個動作施放{@spell See Invisibility}，不需消耗法術位。以此方式施放後，必須完成一次長休，才能再次如此施放。
data/1/entries/7/entries/3/entries/1/ent.reason: 明確寫出一個動作的消耗，保留長休恢復限制。

data/0/entries/11/entries/3/entries/0.english: Every time the characters learn a powerful secret, note it on the Secrets Tracker. Once the characters learn a secret, they can't learn it again. When one character learns a secret, it counts as a secret learned for the whole party.
data/0/entries/11/entries/3/entries/0.zh_tw: 每當角色們得知一個強大的秘密，就將它記錄在秘密追蹤表上。同一個秘密只能計入一次；只要一名角色得知該秘密，就視為整個隊伍都已得知。
data/0/entries/11/entries/3/entries/0.reason: 說明秘密不能重複計入，不是無法再次聽見該資訊。

data/2/entries/10/entries/6/entries/4/en.english: Cultists and agents gather here to commune with Lolth's Abyssal servants and occasionally summon Fiends to assist with missions. The figure at the table is Grottenelle Stonecutter, a chaotic evil, svirfneblin {@creature mage} who serves as the facility's high summoner.
data/2/entries/10/entries/6/entries/4/en.zh_tw: 邪教徒與密探聚集於此，與羅絲的深淵僕從交流，有時也會召喚邪魔協助執行任務。桌旁的人是格羅特妮爾·鑿石，一名混亂邪惡的地底侏儒{@creature mage}，擔任此地的高階召喚師。
data/2/entries/10/entries/6/entries/4/en.reason: 明確保留地底侏儒種族；人名不是巨人種類。

data/2/entries/3/name.reason: Neverdeath 是墓園專名，不是一般「不死」狀態。
